question: Can you help me book both domestic and international flights?
answer: Yes, we help with booking airfares for both domestic and international trips. Whether you're planning a family vacation in Europe or a beach getaway in the Caribbean, we can take care of your flights.

question: Do you assist with car rentals or land transportation?
answer: Yes, we can arrange car rentals and other land transportation as part of your travel package, so your trip runs smoothly from start to finish.

question: Do you plan cruises for families, couples, or solo travelers?
answer: Absolutely. We plan cruises for families, couples, and solo travelers, helping you choose the right cruise line and itinerary to match your style and interests.

question: Can you help me choose the right all-inclusive resort?
answer: Yes. We specialise in finding the perfect all-inclusive resort where everything is covered, so you can relax, play, and make the most of your time together.

question: Do you offer travel insurance?
answer: Yes, we offer travel insurance for all of our packages. It can be added when booking to give you extra protection and peace of mind.

question: Will I get special discounts or perks by booking through you?
answer: Yes. We have access to exclusive discounts, special offers, and added perks you may not find on your own — helping you get the most value out of your trip.

question: Is there a fee for your travel planning services?
answer: In most cases the cost of our service is already included in the price of the vacation package, resort, or cruise. You pay the same price, with the benefit of having us handle every detail.

question: Can you help if I'm not sure where I want to go yet?
answer: Yes! Many clients aren't sure where to start. We take the time to listen to your needs and recommend destinations that match what you're looking for.

question: How far in advance should I start planning my trip?
answer: We recommend planning 6 to 12 months ahead for the best availability — but we can also help with last-minute trips when needed.

question: What happens if I need to change or cancel my trip?
answer: We'll work with you to make any necessary changes and guide you through the process. Adding travel insurance gives extra protection in case plans change unexpectedly.
